Quests.Title: Stone, Not Silence
Quests.Summary: Trace a new mineral stress pattern from the Archive sanctuary through the crystal threshold into its nearby grotto. Bring Dante a physical impression so the guild can brace the inhabited courts. No combat is required.
Quests.Done: The Archive pattern matches the threshold seam. Dante has the impression, the guild has a safer brace plan, and the paid Forge services remain available.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: The court stones have started singing under load. I need a pattern, not a guess. Compare the Archive lectern, then take an impression at the outer crystal seam.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: And if something is nesting there?

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Keep your distance. This is survey work, not a hunting license. Bring the impression back and we can fit the right braces.

Steps.Objective: Enter the Archive and reach the deep sanctuary lectern.
Copy the sanctuary pattern from the survey board beside the lectern.
Walk out to the crystal threshold. You can observe without fighting.
Enter the walk-through mineral grotto, take one impression, then use either mouth to return.
Return the impression to Dante at the original Forge.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Same stress line, same mineral grain. The court braces can spread that load without waking the whole seam. Good work.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Take these materials. If you want a fitting, use the Forge as usual. Materials help, but skilled work still has a price.
